description.short: Designs and reviews Azure infrastructure to the Libre DevOps standards.
description.full: Designs and reviews Azure infrastructure to the Libre DevOps standards. Checks for a published house Terraform module before proposing raw resources, assesses every design against the five Well-Architected pillars and names the trade-off it accepted, takes a position on identity (managed identity then OIDC, never a stored secret), network (private by default, and honest about what that breaks), naming, tagging and resilience, and states the cost MODEL rather than a price, because a confident wrong number gets budgeted against.
